mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved consumer spending and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% in 1 month AND UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to predict positive returns in > 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the early recovery phase (post-pandemic), a rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signals strengthening demand and economic growth, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the early recovery phase, CPIAUCSL rises but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 1.2 million units per month signals strong consumer demand for housing, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to spillover effects on construction, consumer spending, and confidence.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 1200.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (index) over a 3-month period signals a weakening in manufacturing and supply chain activity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and potential recessionary pressures.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 105.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it supports long-term equity valuations through low discount rates and accommodative financial conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending and business investment.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declines > 0.3pp in 1 month AND UNRATE > 6.0%
failure_condition: In the high-unemployment regime, UNRATE declines by more than 0.3pp but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the decline in this regime is below 0.03.
